### Summary

I am having problems using `uv run` in a project which has a dependency on `onnxruntime` in its `pyproject.toml` and a venv using an older (3.10) python version. The issue can be reproduced with the following `pyproject.toml`:

```
[project]
name = "onnxtest"
requires-python = ">=3.10"
dependencies = [
  "onnxruntime",
]
version = "1.0.0"
```

The `uv.lock` file generated as a result is available here https://gist.github.com/enkiusz/4d79a1a4d959d43437789b407f317780

The issue appears only when `pyproject.toml` is present, in an empty directory `uv pip install` and subsequent `uv run` are able to correctly figure out which `onnxruntime` wheel should be installed for compatibility with python 3.10. See below commands run *without* `pyproject.toml` present:

```shell
$ ls -a
.  ..
$ uv venv --python cpython-3.10
Using CPython 3.10.20
Creating virtual environment at: .venv
Activate with: source .venv/bin/activate
$ uv pip install onnxruntime
Resolved 9 packages in 15ms
Installed 9 packages in 28ms
 + coloredlogs==15.0.1
 + flatbuffers==25.12.19
 + humanfriendly==10.0
 + mpmath==1.3.0
 + numpy==2.2.6
 + onnxruntime==1.23.2
 + packaging==26.3
 + protobuf==7.36.2
 + sympy==1.14.0
$ uv run python3
Python 3.13.15 (main, Sep  1 2026, 14:18:08) [Clang 22.1.3 ] on linux
Type "help", "copyright", "credits" or "license" for more information.
>>> import onnxruntime
>>> 
```

I have looked through the existing issues and have found others who have had problems with installing `onnxruntime` or `pytorch` where wheels have wrong metadata or are not available for the platform they use (specifically https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/9425 and https://github.com/astral-sh/uv/issues/5182). I believe my issue is different enough to warrant a new ticket due to the fact that:

1. The issue appears only when `pyproject.toml` is used.
2. The `onnxruntime` wheels now include correct `requires-python` metadata entries for the python version I am trying to use.

### Platform

Ubuntu 24.04.5 LTS x86_64

### Version

uv 0.12.15 (x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.13.15
title: `uv run` cannot properly resolve a dependency on `onnxruntime` declared in `pyproject.toml`
